article.headline: Villanova defeats La Salle 80-59
article.description: — Luigi Suigo had 19 points in Villanova's 80-59 victory over La Salle on Tuesday.
article.story: BRYN MAWR, Pa. -- — Luigi Suigo had 19 points in Villanova's 80-59 victory over La Salle on Tuesday. Suigo had 12 rebounds and five assists for the Wildcats (2-1). Devin Royal scored 15 points and added 10 rebounds. Tyler Perkins had 10 points and shot 4 for 11. RJ Smith led the Explorers (1-2) in scoring, finishing with 13 points. Noah Collier added 11 points and seven rebounds for La Salle. Villanova took the lead for good with 13:44 left in the first half. The score was 36-31 at halftime, with Royal racking up nine points. Villanova outscored La Salle in the second half by 16 points, with Suigo scoring a team-high 13 points after halftime. Up next Up next for Villanova is a Saturday home matchup with Rider. La Salle hosts Temple on Sunday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
